description: Painted sprite for the rebel bishop (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/rebel-bishop.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the rebel BISHOP from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose and tall slim proportions, not for its style. SUBJECT: a shadowy hooded rebel bishop. On his head a tall wide parchment-cream bishop's mitre with straight sides, a pointed cleft top, tan bands up the middle and round the base, and a few small stains. Under it a dark charcoal-grey hood whose opening is a solid black void showing only two round glowing pale-yellow dot eyes, no face, no mouth. A ragged mid-grey cowl with a torn zigzag edge over the shoulders, a long ragged light-grey robe with a torn zigzag hem down to the ankles and one bright yellow square patch stitched on the front, short dark boots. A tall gnarled wooden crook held upright in his right fist on the right side of the figure: a twisted brown branch whose top curls into a small tight hook bending back toward the mitre, about as wide as a fist, its top level with the mitre's peak. His bare right fist is clearly closed round the shaft, the fingers wrapped over it, the staff showing above and below the fist. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the hood and mitre are about half the figure's height. EYES: the two round glowing pale-yellow dot eyes are painted inside the black hood void, side by side, level, clearly visible. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights, earthy greys and parchment with the yellow patch as the one bright accent. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
